name: eza
summary: Modern ls replacement with icons, git status, tree view and a theme.yml file for colors and icons.
configFormat: theme.yml (colors, icons) plus flags/aliases and env vars (EZA_COLORS, LS_COLORS, EZA_ICON_SPACING)

windows.notes: Verified on Windows 11 with eza 0.23.5: EZA_CONFIG_DIR=<dir> loaded <dir>/theme.yml and applied hex colors. The default dir is $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/eza per the docs; set EZA_CONFIG_DIR explicitly on Windows (the default location was not confirmed). On Windows the mode column shows file attribute flags, not Unix permissions.

install.notes: Debian 13 has 0.21.0, Ubuntu 24.04 has 0.18.2 which predates theme.yml; newer builds from the project's deb repo (deb.gierens.de, see INSTALL.md).

theme.notes: theme.yml with hex colors (needs a theme.yml-capable eza, 0.19+), or EZA_COLORS / LS_COLORS.
